quotes.excerpt: Hey! I guess I'll get some conversation started, this interests me too and I've been doing the same the last few years. I added a page to my site [0] to keep updated with all the tech I use so I'll do some copy-pasting of some standouts. Note that I use Linux and Android, no Apple products here. - EndeavourOS - easy to install arch-based linux distro - KDE - desktop environment - Framework 13 - repairable laptop - Pi

quotes.quote: ghost - blogging on my public web server
quotes.excerpt: * PiHole - dns * Jellyfin - videos and such * mealie - recipes * aphorio - my own app for container management, web servers, sockets, and more. It can do 5,000,000 messages person on a single socket roundtrip * gamevault - like Jellyfin for games * there is an audio app I wrote that I use daily * ghost - blogging on my public web server There are some others I run additionally but those listed above are the main ones
